notes.title: DevilishGames and Making Enemies present Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence
notes.content:
[p]Developed by [b]Making Enemies[/b] (Ayose Trujillo) and published by the veteran studio [b]DevilishGames[/b], [i]Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence[/i] is a classic-style [b]point & click[/b] adventure that will transport players to a mysterious abbey where nothing is what it seems.[/p][p][/p][p]In this first installment of the [i]Scholar Adventure[/i] saga, players will play as [b]William[/b], a young writer searching for inspiration for his first novel. His journey takes him to a remote abbey whose monks have taken a vow of silence. What begins as a simple literary quest soon turns into a chilling enigma: within its walls lies a secret that should never have been uncovered.[/p][p][/p][p]Developed with [b]PowerQuest[/b]—the tool also used to create recent hits such as [i]The Drifter[/i]—and inspired by the graphic adventures of the 1990s, [i]Mystery of Silence[/i] combines [b]dark, detailed pixel art[/b] with a deep narrative and touches of black humor. Players will explore atmospheric environments, solve [b]environmental puzzles[/b], and use the objects they find along the way to uncover the abbey’s hidden secrets.[/p][p][/p][p]The experience will have an approximate duration of [b]two hours[/b] and is designed as a [b]tribute to the classics of the genre[/b], focusing on [b]exploration[/b], [b]puzzle-solving[/b], and [b]narrative immersion[/b]. A [b]demo version[/b] of the game will be available during the [b]Steam Next Fest in October[/b].
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929410/Scholar_Adventure_Mystery_of_Silence/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Bambas! arrives on Steam and Consoles this Friday
notes.content:
[p]Lace up your sneakers. DevilishGames is stepping up with Bambas!, a quirky new walking simulator launching this Friday on Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch.[/p][p]Remember when you were a kid, and the streets were your playground, where every curb, puddle, or sidewalk turned into an epic quest? Bambas! brings back that magic with a sandbox experience that takes you on a nostalgic stroll, thanks to its innovative control system.[/p][p]Explore a lively Mediterranean coastal town brimming with personality and detail, where creativity is king and exploration is your passport to fun. Take control of each sneaker independently using the gamepad's sticks and triggers, just like moving your own feet. But walking straight won’t cut it: you’ll have to dodge crosswalks, kick cans, balance on curbs, and pull off impossible jumps to overcome hundreds of challenges and unlock a wardrobe full of customizable sneakers.[/p][p]Bambas! is more than just a game, it’s a tribute to urban culture, to worn-out soles from endless wandering, and to the stories waiting around every corner. With its non-linear narrative and environmental storytelling, you’ll discover hidden places and meet characters who’ll lead you down unexpected paths.[/p][p]Slip on your sneakers and get ready to make your mark, because every step counts here.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3274390/Bambas/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31849972/4fe2514391f517b6bd41042b49c944c142c2329b.jpg[/img]

Add to your wishlist on Steam!!!! >>>> https://store.steampowered.com/app/1229270/Onirike/

Dreams are fed by our own desires. They dwell within us since we are born and so we call them until they come true. But, have you ever wondered what happens to dreams that never come true?

Onirike is an original adventure, puzzles, and 3d platformer video game that plays in an intricate open world, designed with a non-linear narrative, and presented with a peculiar graphics and sound aesthetic.

During the game, the user will take control of Prieto, a strange being that unknowns his nature, but who has the rare ability to become invisible. Exploration, stealth and gypsophila plants grow will be key to unveil the story of Prieto and the orb in which he lives.

Main features:
[list]
[*] Explore Onirike’s intricate open world.
[*] Discover its charming non-linear story.
[*] Be amazed by its peculiar graphics and sound aesthetics.
[*] Gain new abilities for Prieto.
[*] Grow gypsophila strategically.
[*] Avoid dreams devourers using invisibility.
[/list]

Onirike is a project granted by Red.es and European Regional Development Fund (ERDF) through the Red.es Program of Impulse to Videogame Sector. The grants are co-financed by the ERDF in the Multiregional Operational Program of Spain 2014-2020 (POPE).

notes.title: Wot I Think: Path to Mnemosyne
notes.content:
Developer: Devilish Games
Publisher: Devilish Games

Release: 26th September
On: Windows, Mac
From: Steam
Price: 7, $10, 10

As a collection of puzzles Path To Mnemosyne is a peculiar conflation of ingenious and over-familiar, as well as having a name you’ll never remember when you want to find it on Steam later. As a small vignette, it looks beautiful (if slightly held back by clunky controls) offering smart puzzling ideas, in between some of the most hackneyed puzzles you can think of. I rather liked it.

(more…)

notes.title: Path to Mnemosyne will be released at Steam at the end of September
notes.content:
[b]The long-awaited new independent DevilishGames title announces its release date on Steam with a new trailer. The game will be available from September 26th in Windows and Mac versions at a price of $9.99, although during the first days it will have a 10% discount.[/b]

After being exhibited at multiple festivals such as Indie Prize of Casual Connect Europe, MomoCon Indie Game Awards (USA), BIG Festival (Brazil) or A MAZE Berlin, and receiving very positive feedback from the public and press, the DevilishGames studio has decided to make to coincide the launch of Path to Mnemosyne with the company's 20th anniversary celebration of video game development.

Path to Mnemosyne is a hypnotic adventure. It uses the stunning technique of infinite zoom to immerse the player in a journey through his mind in the quest for lost memories. Path to Mnemosyne's mysterious story, minimalist narrative, disturbing graphics, and sound ensure a bizarre and memorable experience for the user.

After the initial launch on Steam, the company also plans to bring the game to PS4, Switch and Xbox One thanks to the agreement announced a few months ago with publisher Hidden Trap.

David Ferriz, co-founder of DevilishGames: [i]"To survive for 20 years in such a changing industry as is the video games one, it's essential to reinvent yourself from time to time and explore new paths you've never thought about before. With Path to Mnemosyne, we have done something very different from all our previous work and we are really looking forward to the imminent release of Steam and later versions for consoles."[/i]

Steam launch trailer: https://youtu.be/GTydQtJEX-4

notes.title: Hello Steam!
notes.content:
After launching King Lucas on the late 2016, DevilishGames starts a new phase of ideation and artistic and technological experimentation to quest our new independent project. The premise during the preproduction phase was to look for artistic, narrative and playable innovation to try to get a unique user experience.

We are currently into developing the project for PC. The name will be: Path to Mnemosyne. Today we have made Steam's page available for you to know about the game and be able to include it in your wish list.
